messages:
marta (Security): Auditor asked for a consolidated evidence index for SOC2 control set — they want RBAC diffs, KMS/key-usage logs, and incident replay artifacts for sampling. Can we standardize a template?
raj (Infra): we can. need to know sampling size + env scope (prod/dedicated/private). Also retention windows for each artifact.
auditor_jones: suggest 5 samples per control across prod + one non-prod. For KMS: rotation + usage + who-triggered events. Chain-of-custody + checksums preferred.
elaine (SRE): SIEM retention is 12mo. For KMS usage we have CloudTrail + Splunk indexing; the Splunk savedsearch `kms_key_usage_agg` contains aggregated usage by key_id.
raj (Infra): I'll schedule Splunk export. quick command: `savedsearch run savedsearch=\"kms_key_usage_agg\" | outputcsv /tmp/kms_usage_prod.csv` and then push to S3.
oliver (Compliance): we also need proof for RBAC changes: git diffs for infra-as-code + API snapshots from Console (rolebinding JSONs) with timestamps and approver metadata.
marta (Security): good. For RBAC diffs include commit hash + PR number + approver. For console snapshots include `kubectl` export + screenshot optional.
elaine (SRE): runbook snippet for oncall to capture RBAC snapshot (will paste below). This should go into the IR playbook so oncall can produce evidence quickly during incidents.
raj (Infra): note on KMS evidence: CloudTrail events to extract: UpdateKeyRotationStatus, DisableKeyRotation, ScheduleKeyDeletion, CreateKey. We'll need eventTime, userIdentity, requestParameters.keyId, responseElements.
auditor_jones: that set looks good. Also we need key material proof (key version id) and rotation history. Signed manifests are preferred, otherwise checksum + presigned S3 URLs ok.
marta (Security): I'll build an evidence-index CSV: columns = [ControlID, ArtifactType, Filename/S3Path, Checksum(sha256), SignedBy, Notes]. Will group entries by control and mark sample rows.
elaine (SRE): runbook snippet: ```bash
# RBAC snapshot + push to evidence bucket
kubectl get rolebinding -A -o json > /tmp/rbac-snapshot-$(date +%s).json
sha256sum /tmp/rbac-snapshot-*.json | tee /tmp/rbac-checksum.txt
aws s3 cp /tmp/rbac-snapshot-*.json s3://redwood-compliance-evidence/eng-security/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control
aws s3 cp /tmp/rbac-checksum.txt s3://redwood-compliance-evidence/eng-security/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control
# annotate S3 object metadata with commit/pr and approver
```
marta (Security): perfect — I'll include that verbatim in the evidence index notes.
raj (Infra): CloudTrail CLI example for KMS extraction: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=EnableKeyRotation --start-time 2025-03-01 --end-time 2026-03-01` then filter by `requestParameters.keyId` and `userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer` for invocations.
auditor_jones: also want a mapping table that crossrefs each control to the specific artifacts (file names) and the extraction command used.
marta (Security): will do. timeline: raj said Splunk/CloudTrail exports by EOD tomorrow, I'll assemble the index once files in S3 and attach CSV.
oliver (Compliance): small ask — for signed manifests, are we using our internal GPG key or a timestamped AWS KMS signature flow? Which is easier for verifiability?
raj (Infra): we can sign manifests with an internal GPG key (key stored in onboarding vault) and also record the KMS CMK id used for envelope encryption. Both can be included in metadata.
elaine (SRE): I'll add an oncall checklist step to the IR playbook: 1) capture RBAC snapshot, 2) run KMS saved searches, 3) push artifacts to evidence bucket, 4) run checksum and sign manifest, 5) notify auditor channel.
marta (Security): sounds good. I'll create the evidence-index CSV template and upload to this thread when exports are done. thanks :thumbsup:
auditor_jones: thanks team — once I get the index I will pick samples and confirm them. If any artifacts require redaction, flag them in the Notes column.
marta (Security): filing follow-up: I'll open a follow-up thread with the CSV attached and a short mapping doc. leaving this thread open for quick checks.
